method: Direct item-body inspection of fifteen consecutive letters in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan using page-resolved extracted text; page boundaries, headings and sequence were checked. No blocked crawler was used.
identity_relation: Three identities (ד׳תרטז, ד׳תרכ, ד׳תרכא) were established directly from item bodies where the conservative index omitted or malformed the number; twelve existing locator-only identities were enriched in place.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: Another letter in the same controversy; not independent proof of the repeated technical, press, voyage or halachic assertions.
The shared tour is not counted repeatedly; the latter letters retain distinct local activity families for their independently stated recommendations.
Related institutional sequence; this letter adds curriculum, staff and cooperation propositions but not an independent seminary project.

identity_correction.scope: The direct page heading and consecutive sequence establish the item identity; no content is inferred from the index key.

blocked_alternatives.source: scripts/acquire_source_content.py and the previously blocked GitHub-hosted candidate path
blocked_alternatives.result: Latest acquisition report is no_candidates with attempted=0; the known HTTP 403 crawler route was not retried.
blocked_alternatives.fallback: Used the authorized user-supplied Kehot publisher scan.

verification_scope: Fifteen letter bodies were inspected across PDF pages 390-409. Incoming correspondence, manuscripts, cited works, institutional records, curricula, budgets, ship records, press reports, medical records and later outcomes were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and locators were recorded; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Yiddish-derived Hebrew paraphrases, secretary signatures, fragments, textual conjectures, historical judgments, medical limits and shared Evidence Families are explicitly preserved.
